A '''Human male''' served aboard [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Elis Helrot/Legends|Elis Helrot's]] ''[[Hinthra]]'', a [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] helped Helrot run the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] as part of a contest organized by the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mal Biron]].
